events.name: Bash
events.head: Check local frontend-v2 clone state
events.input: $ cd ~/tantra-frontend-v2 2>/dev/null && git status -sb | head -5 && git branch -a | grep -iE "pricing|adi-new-ui" ; git log --oneline -3 origin/adi-new-ui 2>/dev/null; ls ~ | grep -i frontend

events.name: Bash
events.head: Fetch and inspect pricing branches
events.input: $ cd ~/tantra-frontend-v2 && git fetch -q origin && git log --oneline -3 origin/adi-new-ui && git branch -r | grep -i lineup; git log --oneline -8 --format='%h %ad %s' --date=short origin/adi-new-ui -- src/lib/billing/pricing.ts; for b in pricing/7-day-trial-1-account pricing/pro-2-accounts pricing/scale-12-accounts pricing/yearly-rounded-scale-10 pricing/yearly-toggle; do echo "== $b"; git log -1 --format='%h %ad %an %s' --date=short origin/$b; git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/$b origin/adi-new-ui && echo merged; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: List branches and adi-new-ui pricing constants
events.input: $ cd ~/tantra-frontend-v2 && git branch -r | grep -vE "pricing/" | head -30; echo; git log --oneline -1 origin/pricing/scale-12-accounts --format=%H | xargs -I{} sh -c 'for b in development main master; do git merge-base --is-ancestor {} origin/$b 2>/dev/null && echo "scale-12 in $b"; done'; echo; grep -nE "^export const" src/lib/billing/pricing.ts | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey items 1, 4, 5, 9 in code
events.input: $ cd ~/tantra-frontend-v2 && echo "--1 SMS"; grep -rn "SMS" src/lib/marketing/enterprise-call.ts | head; echo "--9 calendly/booking"; grep -rnE "CALENDLY|BOOKING_URL|cal\.com" src --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx | grep -v test | head -15; echo "--5 Start Free"; grep -rniE "start free\b|start for free|\"Start Free" src content 2>/dev/null | grep -vi trial | head -20; grep -rn "START_CTA_LABEL" src | head -5; echo "--4 Telegram"; grep -rln -i telegram src/app/\(marketing\)/pricing src/components/marketing 2>/dev/null | head; ls src/app | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read enterprise-call.ts and cta.ts
events.input: $ cd ~/tantra-frontend-v2 && cat src/lib/marketing/enterprise-call.ts | head -60; echo ----; cat src/lib/marketing/cta.ts | head -30

events.text: Checking the 9 pricing items in the tantra-frontend-v2 code. Items 5 and 9 already look fixed on adi-new-ui; I'm surveying the rest now.
